description: Complete a rigged Library character with finger bones (3 phalanges × 5 fingers per hand, Mixamo names) built from its hand mesh — no provider rigs fingers, so without this a hand cannot close on a weapon and pistol/knife clips have nothing to drive. New characters get it automatically in gripforge_generate_character; use this on characters generated before. Updates the item in place. 0 credits. Then re-run gripforge_animate.
name: gripforge_hand_rig
